design_description: A clean, premium design built around a crisp white base with restrained gold detailing for a timeless and elegant appearance. Gold trim on the collar, sleeve cuffs, shoulder stripes, and slim curved side accents frames the jersey, adding definition while preserving the minimalist aesthetic. A subtle tonal micro-texture across the fabric introduces depth without distracting from the clean composition. The uncluttered front keeps the focus on the crest and logos, emphasizing balance, sophistication, and classic football styling. Overall, the jersey feels refined, luxurious, and understated, blending heritage-inspired details with a modern performance silhouette.
